title: Strengthening cyber resilience as AI capabilities advance
summary: OpenAI is investing in stronger safeguards and defensive capabilities as AI models become more powerful in cybersecurity. We explain how we assess risk, limit misuse, and work with the security community to strengthen cyber resilience.
body: OpenAI is investing in stronger safeguards and defensive capabilities as AI models become more powerful in cybersecurity. We explain how we assess risk, limit misuse, and work with the security community to strengthen cyber resilience.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布关于提升网络安全韧性的说明，强调随着AI能力的增强，公司正加大对安全防护与防御性能力的投入。文章阐述了OpenAI如何评估模型风险、限制滥用，并与安全社区合作，以应对AI技术在网络安全领域带来的双刃剑效应。

aiReview.reasonZh: 探讨了AI模型在网络安全领域的防御能力建设，具有重要的行业参考价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 网络韧性，指系统在遭受网络攻击时保持运行并快速恢复的能力。
